description: This file defines a custom exception class EqualAmortizationUnsupportedFeatureException used in the loan product domain of the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception class and provides a specific error message related to unsupported equal amortization features.

classes.name: EqualAmortizationUnsupportedFeatureException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a specific equal amortization feature is unsupported within the loan product domain.

methods.name: EqualAmortizationUnsupportedFeatureException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code and property message related to unsupported equal amortization features.
